Hi!

You can swap a shift by opening the shift in the app and tapping "Ruil aanbieden" (Offer swap). Colleagues with the same role can then accept the swap. A manager then approves the swap under Rooster → Verzoeken (Rota → Requests).

Best regards,
Team Roosterly
